case: rust_decimal capacity boundaries retain typed values through DuckDB parameters and SQL literals
contracts: Positive and negative maximum rust_decimal mantissas round-trip through DuckDB typed parameters and rendered SQL literals.
Maximum rust_decimal scale (28) round-trips through DuckDB typed parameters and rendered SQL literals.
DuckDB SQL literals explicitly cast Decimal values to DECIMAL(precision, scale), preventing integer-looking Decimal literals from decoding as wide-integer text.

clippy.command: rtk cargo clippy --locked -p tablepro-core -p tablepro-driver-duckdb --all-targets -- -D warnings

limits: Embedded DuckDB contract; this does not close DuckDB nested collection/interval limits, other consumers, or the wider B3 matrix.
